editorialIntro.heading: One More Coat of Blue
editorialIntro.paragraph: A late-night rock song plays beneath the desk lamp. Scarlett stands before the unfinished canvas, brush poised, then reaches for the cerulean blue. The cap clicks open. One more coat deepens the color along the edge; she steps back to see it from the doorway. Paint bottles crowd the workbench beneath the tall windows. Her jeans carry a pale streak from an earlier attempt. Beyond the gray curtains, Los Angeles keeps moving. Inside, the blue can have another five minutes.
